up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL232 (Alpha-1B adrenergic receptor). Filter for standard_type IC50, exact standard_relation '=', and non-null pChEMBL values. Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, ac.standard_type, ac.pchembl_value FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN activities ac ON ac.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = ac.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = ac.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL232' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND ac.standard_type = 'IC50' AND ac.standard_relation = '=' AND ac.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
